films.name: Derech
films.quote: I share my work because I want people to see it. It doesn’t mean I want every part of my life to be public. Having that choice matters to me.
films.bio: Ilan Derech is a Mexico-born, Tokyo-based visual artist whose work distills fleeting human moments into contemplative, cinematic experiences. With roots in motion graphics, 3D design, and generative coding, he evolved into a filmmaker and photographer known for capturing emotional atmospheres.

films.name: Josh Ong
films.quote: When I got into crypto, I was already doxxed, so sharing publicly came naturally. Becoming a father changed how I think about privacy - and the importance of protecting my family.
films.bio: Josh Ong is a longtime Web3 operator, investor, and collector, best known as co-founder of Bored Room Ventures and an early member of the Bored Ape Yacht Club community. Today, he advises Web3 and AI projects while serving as Co-COO and Partner, Web3 at NewChic Capital.

films.name: CryptoVonDoom
films.quote: Privacy, to me, means being able to choose what I share and with whom.  I still want to be open and accessible, but I want to make that choice consciously, especially when something involves other people’s privacy too.
films.bio: VonDoom is an entrepreneur and collector who turns ideas into businesses and brings people together around art, culture, community and emerging technology.
